items.name: vellum-theme
items.title: Vellum theme
items.description: Vellum design tokens: colours, field and control tokens, shadows, radius scale (light and dark).

items.name: account-menu
items.title: Account Menu
items.description: The menu body on its own: user summary, manage/sign-out actions, other signed-in accounts and "Add account".

items.name: account-profile
items.title: Account Profile
items.description: Settings shell: title and vertical nav on the muted rail, the active section in a white panel. Nav scrolls horizontally on narrow screens.

items.name: api-keys-card
items.title: Api Keys Card
items.description: Visible prefix, e.g. "ak_live_".

items.name: auth-page
items.title: Auth Page
items.description: Full-page auth layout: soft centered glow on the canvas, a centered card slot and a copyright/links footer.

items.name: auth-sign-in
items.title: Auth Sign In
items.description: Glyph shown before the label. Defaults to a monogram of the label.

items.name: auth-sign-up
items.title: Auth Sign Up
items.description: Sign-up card: logo, provider buttons, email and password (with show/hide), primary continue and a link to sign in.

items.name: auth-waitlist
items.title: Auth Waitlist
items.description: Waitlist card: email field and a join button, swapping to a confirmation once submitted.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: Inline notice for page-level context ("Use this development instance for test users…").

items.name: create-user-dialog
items.title: Create User Dialog
items.description: "Create new user" dialog with Create / Invite tabs, optional name fields, password visibility toggle and inline validation.

items.name: create-wizard
items.title: Create Wizard
items.description: "identifier" options become the preview's text field; the rest render as provider buttons.

items.name: cta-section
items.title: Cta Section
items.description: Large round mark used as the card's decorative art.

items.name: dashboard-shell
items.title: Dashboard Shell
items.description: Breadcrumb-style menu trigger: flat until hovered or open, then a raised white chip.

items.name: data-table-card
items.title: Data Table Card
items.description: Makes the column sortable. Return `null` for "no value" (sorts as lowest).

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: Length of the window ending at "now", in milliseconds.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Centered empty state: icon tile, title, supporting copy and optional actions. Sits inside a card or table body.

items.name: faq-section
items.title: Faq Section
items.description: Accordion list of questions, one open at a time. Use inside your own section layout.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature Grid
items.description: Small label above a section title.

items.name: feature-upsell
items.title: Feature Upsell
items.description: Illustration for the 244×151 card; `active` is true for the centered card.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: Fixed choices render as a checkbox list; omit for a free-text field.

items.name: hero-section
items.title: Hero Section
items.description: Pill that copies a prompt to the clipboard: stacked bubbles, label and a copy glyph that swaps to a check.

items.name: integration-cards
items.title: Integration Cards
items.description: Secondary line under the name, usually the partner's domain.

items.name: invite-member-dialog
items.title: Invite Member Dialog
items.description: Invite-member dialog: email and role fields with inline validation, Cancel / Invite footer.

items.name: members-card
items.title: Members Card
items.description: ISO date, formatted deterministically.

items.name: pricing-plans
items.title: Pricing Plans
items.description: Per-month prices; leave both `null` for a free or custom plan and set `label` ("Free", "Custom").

items.name: settings-card
items.title: Settings Card
items.description: Height-animated disclosure region; content is `inert` while closed.

items.name: settings-sidebar
items.title: Settings Sidebar
items.description: Grouped settings navigation: section headings, plain links and collapsible groups with a guide rail.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site Footer
items.description: One dotted hairline that runs past its box by 1.25rem and fades out at both ends.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site Header
items.description: Default logo: a round mark and a lowercase wordmark. Pass your own through `logo`.

items.name: testimonials-section
items.title: Testimonials Section
items.description: True when the viewer asked for reduced motion; false during server render.

items.name: workspace-switcher
items.title: Workspace Switcher
items.description: Your role in it ("Admin", "Member"). Omit for a personal workspace.

items.name: vellum-skill
items.title: Vellum skill
items.description: Agent skill: how to build UI with Vellum (setup, variants, composition, styling rules).

items.name: vellum-design
items.title: Vellum DESIGN.md
items.description: The Vellum design spec (tokens, elevation, shapes, variant rules, do's and don'ts).
